guest.line1: Uri gukina nk’umushyitsi — aho ugeze habikwa muri iyi mushakisha.
guest.line2: kugira ngo ukine no ku bindi bikoresho.
language.coverage: Ubugenzura n’inyandiko z’ibyabaye mu mukino byahinduwe. Bimwe mu bikubiye mu mwuga bikoresha ururimi rusanzwe.
language.hint: Shakisha ukoresheje izina kavukire, izina ryahinduwe cyangwa kode y’ururimi.
match.eventsEmpty: Ibyabaye bigaragara hano umukino umaze gutangira.
narration.hint: Kurikirana buri kintu cy’ingenzi ukoresheje ijwi, inyandiko cyangwa byombi.
narration.title: Inkuru y’umukino n’inyandiko
narration.unavailable: Nta jwi rya mushakisha ririho muri uru rurimi. Inyandiko ziracyaboneka.
nav.searchHint: Andika igice, hanyuma ugihitemo kugira ngo ujye aho kiri.
quick.description: Hitamo ikipe yawe n’iyo muhanganye. Mudasobwa igenzura indi kipe. Umwuga wawe ntuhinduka.
quick.hint: Imiterere y’abakinnyi, ingufu zabo n’amayeri na byo bigira ingaruka ku musaruro.
quick.title: Umukino wihuse
screen.noCareerHint: Hitamo ikipe, wubake itsinda ry’abakinnyi maze utangire shampiyona.

shell.localSave: Umwuga wawe ubitswe kuri iki gikoresho.
shortcuts.hint: Koresha utubuto twa klavye mu kuyobora no kugenzura umukino.
shortcuts.title: Utubuto twihuse
studio.cameraHint: Kurura kugira ngo uzengurutse, cyangwa ukoreshe buto za kamera. Igenzura ryose rikoresha klavye.
studio.clothHint: Gerageza uko imyambaro irambuye yitwara mu kwiruka, guhindukira no kugwa.
studio.phaseHint: Hagarara ku ishusho iyo ari yo yose kugira ngo usuzume uko umukinnyi yishingikiriza n'aho akora ku mupira.
studio.title: Buri kantu k’umukinnyi.
